The adjective form modifying "type of pain" should be the single word "everyday." "Every day" (two words) is an adverbial phrase.
Steno/phonetic error. The speaker was asked to spell a name and clearly meant "first name," not "first same."
Typo or steno error. "I'll" (I will) does not fit grammatically with "going." The speaker almost certainly said "I'm" (I am).
